mnemonic.meaning: Two fat kanji (脂, 肪): body fat.
mnemonic.reading: SHE BOW (しぼう): she bows and her body fat jiggles. Same sound as 死亡 (death) and 志望 (wish).

examples.ja: 脂肪の少ない肉を選んだ。
examples.en: I chose lean meat.

items.note: 体脂肪 = body fat. 脂 (Level 19) is grease.

mnemonic.meaning: 福 has 礻 (altar): prayers at the altar bring good fortune.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, COO (ふく): a lucky pigeon brings good fortune. Same sound as 服 (clothes).

examples.ja: 笑う門には福来る。
examples.en: Fortune comes to a merry home.

items.note: 幸福 = happiness. 福袋 = lucky bag sold at New Year.

mnemonic.meaning: 焚 has 火 (fire) under 林 (woods): wood on fire. To make a fire.
mnemonic.reading: TACO (たく): you make a fire to cook the taco.

examples.ja: キャンプで火を焚いた。
examples.en: We made a fire at the campsite.

items.note: Burning wood or incense: 線香を焚く. 焚き火 = bonfire.

mnemonic.meaning: Write (記) it in (入). Filling in a form.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, NEW (きにゅう): fill in the form to get a new key.

examples.ja: この用紙に名前を記入してください。
examples.en: Please write your name on this form.

items.note: For forms and documents. 書き込む is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Small (小) coins (銭). Small change.
mnemonic.reading: COZY, NEE (こぜに): the coins sit cozy on your knee.

examples.ja: 小銭がなくて、バスに乗れなかった。
examples.en: I had no change, so I couldn't take the bus.

items.note: 小銭入れ = coin purse.

mnemonic.meaning: Goods (品) for eating (食). Food products.
mnemonic.reading: SHOCK, HEN (しょくひん): you're shocked: the hen is in the food aisle.

examples.ja: 食品売り場は地下にある。
examples.en: The food section is in the basement.

items.note: Food as a product: 冷凍食品 (frozen food), 食品会社.

mnemonic.meaning: 僧 has 亻 (person) + 曽: a person of the temple. A Buddhist monk.
mnemonic.reading: SO (そう): the monk says "So..." and meditates.

examples.ja: 寺には若い僧が住んでいる。
examples.en: A young monk lives at the temple.

items.note: お坊さん is the everyday, friendly word.

mnemonic.meaning: 炊 has 火 (fire): cook rice over fire.
mnemonic.reading: TACO (たく): you cook rice next to the tacos. Same sound as 焚く (burn).

examples.ja: 毎朝ご飯を炊く。
examples.en: I cook rice every morning.

items.note: Mainly for rice. 炊飯器 = rice cooker. In Kansai also for simmering: 炊いたん.

mnemonic.meaning: 郡 has 阝 (village) + 君 (lord): the lord's villages. A county.
mnemonic.reading: GOON (ぐん): the goon runs the county.

examples.ja: 祖母は長野県の木曽郡に住んでいる。
examples.en: My grandmother lives in Kiso District, Nagano Prefecture.

items.note: In addresses: 〜郡〜町.

mnemonic.meaning: Lacking (欠) and fallen into (陥) a hole. A defect, a flaw.
mnemonic.reading: KECK, CAN (けっかん): the can has a flaw. Same sound as 血管 (blood vessel).

examples.ja: この車にはブレーキに欠陥があった。
examples.en: This car had a defect in its brakes.

items.note: Serious faults in products or systems. 欠点 is a weak point.

mnemonic.meaning: Perform (演) in public (公). A performance.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, EN (こうえん): a Coke at the show. Same sound as 公園 (park).

examples.ja: 劇団の公演を見に行った。
examples.en: I went to see the theatre company's performance.

items.note: Plays, concerts, dance. 講演 (also こうえん) is a lecture.

mnemonic.meaning: Check (勘) and fix (定) the amount. The bill.
mnemonic.reading: CAN, JOE (かんじょう): "Can Joe pay the bill?" Same sound as 感情 (emotion).

examples.ja: お勘定をお願いします。
examples.en: The bill, please.

items.note: Old-fashioned for the bill; お会計 (Level 19) is more common now. 勘定に入れる = take into account.

mnemonic.meaning: 税 has 禾 (grain): grain paid to the lord. Tax.
mnemonic.reading: ZAY (ぜい): "Zay, how much tax?"

examples.ja: この値段は税込みです。
examples.en: This price includes tax.

items.note: 税金 = tax money. 消費税 = consumption tax. 税込み / 税抜き = incl. / excl. tax.

mnemonic.meaning: East (東) ocean (洋). The Orient, Asia.
mnemonic.reading: TOE, YO (とうよう): "Toe, yo!" You dip your toe in the eastern ocean.

examples.ja: 東洋の文化に興味がある。
examples.en: I'm interested in Eastern culture.

items.note: Opposite: 西洋 (せいよう, the West).

mnemonic.meaning: 添 has 氵 (water): flowing alongside. To accompany.
mnemonic.reading: SO (そう): "So, I'll accompany you."

examples.ja: ご期待に添えるよう頑張ります。
examples.en: I'll do my best to meet your expectations.

items.note: Formal: 期待に添う. 寄り添う = to snuggle up, stay close.

mnemonic.meaning: 弱 is weak: you make it weaker. To turn down.
mnemonic.reading: YO, WAH, MAY, RUE (よわめる): May turns down the heat and rues it.

examples.ja: 火を弱めてください。
examples.en: Please turn down the heat.

items.note: Transitive partner of 弱まる (Level 16).

mnemonic.meaning: The generation (代) near (近) us. Modern times.
mnemonic.reading: KIN DIE (きんだい): your kin will die in modern times.

examples.ja: 近代の日本は急速に発展した。
examples.en: Modern Japan developed rapidly.

items.note: In Japanese history, roughly Meiji to WWII. 現代 (Level 9) is the present day.

mnemonic.meaning: Cut off (絶) and destroy (滅). Extinction.
mnemonic.reading: ZETS, METS (ぜつめつ): the Mets went extinct.

examples.ja: この鳥は絶滅しそうだ。
examples.en: This bird is close to extinction.

items.note: 絶滅危惧種 = endangered species.

mnemonic.meaning: Not (不) even (平). Complaint, discontent.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, HAY (ふへい): the foo dog complains about the hay.

examples.ja: 彼は不平ばかり言っている。
examples.en: He does nothing but complain.

items.note: 不平を言う = to complain. 不満 (Level 3) is the feeling; 不平 is voicing it.

mnemonic.meaning: A fixed (定) period (期). Regular, periodic.
mnemonic.reading: TAY, KEY (ていき): the regular train pass is the key.

examples.ja: 定期的に歯医者に行っている。
examples.en: I go to the dentist regularly.

items.note: 定期券 = commuter pass, often just 定期. 定期的 = regular.

mnemonic.meaning: 反 is against: it bends back against itself.
mnemonic.reading: SO, RUE (そる): so it bends backward, and you rue it. Same sound as 剃る (shave).

examples.ja: 板が湿気で反ってしまった。
examples.en: The board warped from the humidity.

items.note: Godan: 反った. Also leaning back: 体を反らす.

mnemonic.meaning: The country's (国) language (語). Japanese as a school subject.
mnemonic.reading: COCK, GO (こくご): the rooster goes to Japanese class.

examples.ja: 国語の授業で作文を書いた。
examples.en: I wrote an essay in Japanese class.

items.note: In Japanese schools, 国語 is the Japanese-language subject.

mnemonic.meaning: 射 is shoot: light shoots in.
mnemonic.reading: SA, SUE (さす): the sunlight shines on Sue. Same sound as 刺す (stab).

examples.ja: 窓から朝日が射している。
examples.en: The morning sun is shining in through the window.

items.note: For light; often written 差す. 日が差す = the sun shines.

mnemonic.meaning: Water (水) level (準). A standard.
mnemonic.reading: SWEE, JUNE (すいじゅん): in June, the water level rises.

examples.ja: この国の生活水準は高い。
examples.en: The standard of living in this country is high.

items.note: 生活水準 = standard of living. レベル is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: The flat (平) line (線) of the earth (地). The horizon.
mnemonic.reading: CHEE, HAY, SEN (ちへいせん): cheese and hay on the horizon.

examples.ja: 地平線に太陽が沈んだ。
examples.en: The sun sank below the horizon.

items.note: On land. Over the sea it's 水平線 (すいへいせん).

mnemonic.meaning: Refined (精) and skilful (巧). Elaborate, precise.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, COKE (せいこう): "Say, this Coke can is so precise!" Same sound as 成功 (success).

examples.ja: この時計はとても精巧に作られている。
examples.en: This watch is very finely made.

items.note: For craftsmanship and machines.

mnemonic.meaning: Damp (湿) air (気). Humidity.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, KAY (しっけ): she and Kay hate the humidity.

examples.ja: 梅雨は湿気が多い。
examples.en: It's very humid in the rainy season.

items.note: 湿度 (Level 22) is the measured humidity.

mnemonic.meaning: Pass (通) and go (行). Traffic, passing.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, COKE (つうこう): you pass the Coke truck in traffic.

examples.ja: この道は車の通行が多い。
examples.en: There's a lot of traffic on this road.

items.note: 通行止め = road closed. 一方通行 = one-way.

mnemonic.meaning: 題 has 頁 (head): the head of the page. A title.
mnemonic.reading: DIE (だい): "Die Hard" is the title.

examples.ja: 作文の題を考えた。
examples.en: I thought of a title for my essay.

items.note: 題名 = title. Also used in 話題 (topic).

mnemonic.meaning: 椀 has 木 (wood): a wooden bowl.
mnemonic.reading: WAN (わん): one wooden bowl.

examples.ja: お椀にみそ汁を入れた。
examples.en: I poured miso soup into a bowl.

items.note: Usually お椀. A ceramic bowl is often 碗 (茶碗).
